newsitem.title: CAYMAN ISLANDS: Cayman Water rejects Argyle buyout bid.
newsitem.headline: Cayman Water rejects Argyle buyout bid.

text.p: Cayman Water Co's board of directors has rejected a take-over offer from minority shareholder Argyle Partners Limited, the company said.

Argyle, whose sole shareholder is J. Bruce Bugg of San Antonio, Texas, wants to buy 50.1 percent of Cayman Water Co, one of two suppliers of fresh water to the western Caribbean British territory, Cayman Water said in a news release issued Monday. Argyle has said in a government filing it also wants to buy
a government water authority. The two transactions, if successful, would give Argyle full control of the territory's fresh water, which is produced by desalination.
A household of four pays US$125 a month for water in the territory, according to government figures. The water organizations have combined revenues of about $30 million a year.
Argyle, which has said it will oust the management of Cayman Water Co if it wins control, now holds 9.65 percent of Cayman Water Co.
